name: Rubric
tagline: A student dashboard that unifies course platforms with an AI assistant that quizzes from your own PDFs.

awards: Best Athena AI Agent for University Students

problem: Students juggle too many course platforms.
solution: Connects the learning management system to one dashboard with a chatbot that generates quizzes from course files, scheduling and live group whiteboards, on cloud infrastructure.
demo_moment: Team-described: open a course and generate a quiz from its slides.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Best Athena AI Agent for University Students” among 127 submissions.
Uses the sponsor's agent as the study assistant.

lessons: Student-focused sponsor briefs favour one hub over another tool.
